name: Blanka
description: Super speed with brutal damage! Omnistrikes deliver massive damage vs Aliens and annihilate Barriers!

name: Dhalsim
description: Perfectly balanced for superior fighting power. Area attacks have 100% chance to inflict Weaken on Traitless.

name: Ken
description: Toughest of the tough, with fast feet to close down baddies! Strong vs Red, Floating & Angels, with Omnistrikes that Knockback enemies!

name: E. Honda
description: Fast movement speed and mighty defense! Extra-tough versus Angels, with Area attacks that Knockback!

name: Sagat
description: A hero with rapid, high-powered Area attacks! Massive damage to Floating enemies, while getting stronger after taking damage!

name: M. Bison
description: Hero able to attack enemies in a wide Omnistrike area! Strong vs. Floating, Alien and Zombie enemies. Able to break Alien Barriers and stop Zombie enemies from reviving

name: Luke
description: A speedy hero striking with rapid Area attacks! Strong vs any enemy with a Trait. Small chance to deliver a Savage Blow, with Shield Piercing.

name: Juri
description: A long-range attacker that deals increased damage to Colossi while taking less damage from them. Deals increased damage to Behemoths while taking less damage from them and also may dodge their attacks. Strong against Floating and Angels with a 100% chance to Freeze/Slow them. Immune to Waves.

name: Akuma
description: High-frequency long-range attacks! Insane area damage to Traitless enemies.

name: C. Honda
description: A rapid-fire Area attacker with might defense to boot! Extra tough versus Angel enemies.

name: Zangief Cat
description: Hero combining both powerful attacks and sturdy defense. Deals Massive damage to Floating with area attacks that have a chance to deal a Savage Blow.

name: Jamie Cat
description: Long-range attack specialist with sturdy defense. Strong against Aku. Immune to Surge damage, with attack power strengthened as they take damage.

name: Balrog Cat
description: Cost-effective hero with a long attack range! Strong versus Black enemies.

name: Vega Cat
description: Cost-effective hero with powerful attacks. Strong vs. Angel enemies, with immunity to Toxic!

name: Sagat Cat
description: Cost-effective hero with rapid-fire attacks! Strong vs. Floating, with immunity to Wave damage!

name: M. Bison Cat
description: A long-distance Area attack specialist hero! Tough vs. Aliens, with a small chance to break enemy Barriers.
